purpose: Inputs of the D3D12 layer recipe (x86_64 PE d3d12.dll). Everything the build downloads is listed here with a digest; nothing else is read from the network.

directx_headers.note: gitlink include/native/directx of the DXMT tree; the working d3d12.dll was built with exactly this content

stand_ins.why: d3d12.dll links the import library of winemetal.dll, and only that library's export table matters; the Wine libraries winemetal.dll itself links against are stood in by a one-file libwinecrt0 (build/repro110layer/winecrt0_stub.c) and the mingw-w64 libntdll/libdbghelp. native_llvm_path only has to exist (the macOS side is not part of this target). Proven equal: local build with real Wine and LLVM and with the stand-ins give the same d3d12.dll.

working_file.name: d3d12.dll (Elden Ring, build v6)
working_file.note: TimeDateStamp of the COFF header and of the debug directory entries is the only part that differs between two links of the same objects; the recipe sets it to link_timestamp before hashing.

embedded_metallib.note: d3d12.dll embeds the Metal library compiled from src/dxmt/*.metal by the runner's Xcode. A different Metal compiler version gives different bytes there and shifts the rest of the file; the 18 object files do not depend on it.

extra_objects_note: The 19th object of the working file's link (../d3d10/d3d10_blob.cpp); its digest prefix is that of the object file the working link used.
